title: Petition by New England Telephone and Telegraph Company requesting approximately 387' of underground conduit, a telephone manhole (precast 12'x6'x7'), a telephone electronics cabinet together with 5'x7' concrete foundation pad. The said requests are to be placed in public ways which are under the jurisdiction of the Metropolitan District Commission, namely, Middlesex Avenue, Fellsway, and Revere Beach Parkway in Medford, Massachusetts.
petitioner: New England Telephone and Telegraph Company
